args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark
args.body:
June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- PHL also matches Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal rows), so filtering on "PHL" returns both businesses.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That label needs to change to Pellow Home Living.

Sent from Sofia Marchetti's request via assistant.
